Antigravity Plugin Switcher

Google Antigravity 2.0 项目级插件独立隔离与热切换控制台
按项目智能切换启用插件集，内置全局默认基准、下拉内嵌批量同步与独立小窗操控。

> 告别插件冗余与上下文污染：专为 Google Antigravity 2.0（并行多智能体桌面客户端，含左侧项目会话树与右侧 Auxiliary Pane 辅助侧边栏）打造。解决全局共用单一 config.json 导致不同项目与纯聊天会话间插件互相干扰、浪费 Token 与上下文窗口的痛点，为每个项目构建专属的插件运行环境。 --- ## ✨ 核心特性 - 项目级独立隔离：每个项目拥有独立的插件启用状态档案，项目切换时自动秒级切换插件集，彻底告别不相关插件对 Prompt 上下文的过度消耗。 - 全局基准默认继承：提供全局默认配置档案（Default Profile），新创建或未定制的项目自动继承默认基准，已定制项目支持随时一键重置对齐。 - 纯聊天会话智能隔离：智能感知无物理工作区的纯聊天窗口，阻断重型开发插件载入，保持日常问答的高信噪比与极速响应。 - 下拉内嵌批量修改：在项目下拉面板内直接开启批量修改模式，支持一键全选与多目标勾选，开关操作跨项目毫秒级批量生效。 - 双态同步与热重载：打通 Antigravity 宿主原生 Settings 与 Sidecar 面板，无论是面板拨动还是软件原生设置变更，均可实现毫秒级双向感知。 - 独立小窗极速操控：内置 8088 固定端口独立 Web 服务，支持通过独立桌面应用小窗直接操控全局与项目插件，完美兼容 GCP 登录环境。 - 双语支持与主题自适应：原生集成中英双语即时切换与持久化，深度联动宿主暗色与浅色色彩系统。 --- ## 🔄 核心工作流原理 ```mermaid flowchart TD A["用户切换项目会话 / 发起工具调用"] --> B["PreToolUse / UserPromptSubmit 钩子触发"] B --> C{"四级项目裁决引擎定位当前项目"} C -- "命中项目独立档案" --> D["加载该项目专属插件集"] C -- "未定制项目 / 纯聊天会话" --> E["继承 Default Profile 全局默认基准"] D --> F["原子化覆写宿主 config.json 并热重载"] E --> F F <--> G["8088 Sidecar 面板 / 独立小窗双向实时同步"] ``` --- ## 🚀 快速安装 本项目采用纯原生 Node.js 构建，零外部依赖（Zero Dependencies），克隆即可运行，无需执行 npm install。 ### 1. 克隆插件至 Antigravity 插件目录 macOS / Linux: ```bash git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/plugin-switcher ``` Windows (PowerShell): ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\plugin-switcher" ``` Windows (CMD): ```cmd git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\plugin-switcher ``` ### 2. 生效与启动 克隆完成后，重启 Google Antigravity 或在插件列表中点击启用即可生效。 --- ## 📂 模块化目录结构 ``` plugin-switcher/ ├── assets/ # 品牌矢量图标 ├── docs/ # 深度技术架构文档 ├── sidecars/ │ └── panel/ # 原生免构建前后端分离 Sidecar 面板 │ ├── app.js # 前端核心交互引擎与状态同步 │ ├── i18n.js # 前端多语言字典与国际化 │ ├── index.html # 前端纯骨架页面 │ ├── ls-bridge.mjs # 后端宿主 RPC 与原子写盘 │ ├── main.mjs # 后端 HTTP 路由入口与静态托管 │ ├── scanner.mjs # 后端项目扫描与四级裁决打分 │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar 容器清单契约 │ └── styles.css # 现代化自适应主题样式表 ├── auto-switch.cjs # 会话生命周期 Hook 拦截器 ├── hooks.json # Antigravity Hook 契约 ├── open-panel.bat # 独立小窗模式快速启动脚本 ├── plugin.json # 插件公开元数据契约 ├── project-plugin-profiles.example.json # 示例配置档案 ├── README.en.md # 英文说明文档 └── README.md # 中文说明文档 ``` --- ## 📖 使用方法指南 ### 1. 单项目独立配置 在 Antigravity 界面右侧辅助栏（Auxiliary Pane）打开「项目插件开关」面板： - 下拉框右侧带绿色圆点代表当前宿主正在运行的活跃项目。 - 下拉框左侧带蓝色对勾代表当前正在查看与编辑的配置档案。 - 直接拨动插件卡片右侧的开关，配置将即时写盘并向宿主发送热加载通知。 ### 2. 全局默认配置（Default Profile） - 在顶部项目下拉菜单中选择「默认配置」。 - 设定的插件状态将作为所有未单独定制项目的基准开关状态。 - 对于已有独立定制的项目，界面会浮现「重置为默认」按钮，点击并确认后即可快速恢复与默认基准对齐。 ### 3. 下拉内嵌批量修改（Batch Edit） - 点击顶部控制栏的「批量修改」按钮，下拉菜单将自动展开。 - 首行呈现「全选」复选框与动态已选计数标签。 - 勾选需要同步的多个目标项目，随后拨动任意插件开关或点击「重置为默认」，即可一键完成跨项目批量同步。 ### 4. 独立小窗模式（兼容 GCP 登录） 若未打开右侧辅助栏，或处于 GCP 远程登录等特殊环境： - 双击插件目录下的 open-panel.bat（或 打开插件开关面板.bat）。 - 或直接在任意现代浏览器中访问 http://127.0.0.1:8088。 - 控制台将以独立小窗模式拉起，与宿主保持完全一致的配置操控体验。 --- ## 📚 官方技术文档中心 | 模块名称 | 说明与技术细节 | 链接 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 系统架构设计 | 四级裁决算法、双态同步、隐藏 Iframe 监听防抢与 API 规范 | [查看架构文档](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) | | 示例配置档案 | 包含默认档案与单项目独立配置的标准 JSON 模板 | [查看示例配置](project-plugin-profiles.example.json) | --- ## 🤝 贡献与共创团队 - [Toru Olenyeva](https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva) - [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) --- ## 📄 开源协议 本项目基于 [MIT License](LICENSE) 开源。

Antigravity Plugin Switcher

Per-Workspace Plugin Isolation & Live Toggle Console for Google Antigravity 2.0
Automatically switch active plugin sets per project with global baseline inheritance, inline batch editing, and standalone window control.

> Eliminate plugin bloat and context pollution: Purpose-built for Google Antigravity 2.0 (the parallel agent desktop application featuring the left-hand project tree and right-hand HTML Auxiliary Pane). Solve the critical issue where sharing a single global config.json across all projects and chat sessions wastes context window and tokens. --- ## ✨ Key Features - Project-Level Isolation: Maintain independent plugin toggle profiles per workspace. Switching workspaces instantly switches active plugins, preventing irrelevant tools from polluting system prompts. - Global Default Baseline: Set up a Default Profile inherited by all newly created or non-customized projects. Customized projects can be realigned with one click. - Chat Session Smart Isolation: Detect directory-free chat sessions automatically and inhibit heavy development plugins to maximize response speed and prompt signal-to-noise ratio. - Inline Batch Editing: Open batch edit mode directly inside the project selector dropdown. Support select all and multi-target selection to sync plugin toggles across multiple projects simultaneously. - Dual-Way Live Sync: Seamlessly connect the Antigravity host native Settings and the Sidecar panel, synchronizing toggle states in real time regardless of where the modification occurs. - Standalone Window Mode: Built-in fixed port 8088 web server allows direct control via an independent desktop app window, fully compatible with GCP remote login environments. - Bilingual Support and Theme Adaptation: Native English and Chinese runtime localization with persistent storage, matching the host dark and light color systems automatically. --- ## 🔄 Core Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A["User Switches Workspace / Triggers Tool Call"] --> B["PreToolUse / UserPromptSubmit Hook Fires"] B --> C{"4-Tier Resolution Engine Identifies Active Workspace"} C -- "Custom Workspace Profile Found" --> D["Load Dedicated Workspace Plugin Set"] C -- "Uncustomized Workspace / Pure Chat" --> E["Inherit Global Default Profile Baseline"] D --> F["Atomically Update Host config.json & Hot-Reload"] E --> F F <--> G["Port 8088 Sidecar Panel / Standalone Window Live Sync"] ``` --- ## 🚀 Quick Installation Built with native Node.js and Zero Dependencies. Clone and run immediately without executing npm install. ### 1. Clone into Antigravity Plugins Directory macOS / Linux: ```bash git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/plugin-switcher ``` Windows (PowerShell): ```powershell git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\plugin-switcher" ``` Windows (CMD): ```cmd git clone https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva/antigravity-plugin-switcher.git %USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\plugin-switcher ``` ### 2. Enable and Launch Restart Google Antigravity or enable the plugin in the Antigravity Plugins settings tab. --- ## 📂 Modular Project Structure ``` plugin-switcher/ ├── assets/ # Brand assets and vector logos ├── docs/ # Deep technical architecture documentation ├── sidecars/ │ └── panel/ # Native build-free decoupled Sidecar panel │ ├── app.js # Frontend interaction and state sync engine │ ├── i18n.js # Frontend internationalization dictionary │ ├── index.html # Frontend HTML skeleton structure │ ├── ls-bridge.mjs # Backend host RPC bridge and disk persistence │ ├── main.mjs # Backend HTTP routing and static server │ ├── scanner.mjs # Backend workspace scanner and 4-tier engine │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar container manifest │ └── styles.css # Responsive adaptive stylesheet ├── auto-switch.cjs # Host lifecycle Hook interceptor ├── hooks.json # Antigravity Hook configuration ├── open-panel.bat # Standalone window quick launcher script ├── plugin.json # Plugin manifest ├── project-plugin-profiles.example.json # Example profile configuration ├── README.en.md # English documentation └── README.md # Chinese documentation ``` --- ## 📖 Usage Guide ### 1. Workspace Profile Customization Open the Project Plugin Switcher tab in the right Auxiliary Pane: - The green dot on the right indicates the active project currently running in the host. - The blue checkmark on the left indicates the profile currently being viewed and modified. - Toggle any plugin card switch to apply changes immediately and notify the host language server. ### 2. Global Default Profile - Select "Default Profile" at the top of the project dropdown. - Configured plugin states act as the default baseline for all uncustomized projects. - For projects with custom overrides, a "Reset to Default" button will appear, allowing one-click realignment with the baseline. ### 3. Inline Batch Edit - Click the "Batch Edit" button on the top control bar to expand the dropdown menu. - The top header displays a "Select All" checkbox alongside a live selected counter. - Check target projects and flip any switch or reset to synchronize settings across all selected projects at once. ### 4. Standalone Window Mode (GCP Compatible) When running without the Auxiliary Pane or inside remote cloud desktop sessions: - Double click open-panel.bat in the plugin root folder. - Or navigate to http://127.0.0.1:8088 in any modern browser. - The control console will launch in an isolated window with the identical experience. --- ## 📚 Documentation Matrix | Module | Description & Technical Details | Link | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | System Architecture | Four-tier resolution algorithm, dual-way sync, hidden iframe observer guards, and API specs | [View Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.en.md) | | Example Profile Configuration | Standard JSON structure containing default profile and project overrides | [View Example Config](project-plugin-profiles.example.json) | --- ## 🤝 Contributors & Credits - [Toru Olenyeva](https://github.com/ToruOlenyeva) - [Google Antigravity](https://antigravity.google/) --- ## 📄 License This project is licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).
